blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Consumer group Progreso Para sa Bayan urged Philippine authorities to wrap up their investigation into an alleged cross-border cigarette operation in Cebu and prosecute those implicated by the evidence, after the case drew scrutiny in Malaysia’s Parliament. More than seven months after the Apr. 10 raid, Tasek Gelugor lawmaker Wan Saifulruddin Wan Jan raised the case before Parliament’s Special Chamber on Nov. 24.
